note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. The axis is the worse of executable venue depth and primary redemption. Pool TVL is context only and is never substituted for executable depth.

depth.slippage_convention: marginal execution-rate deterioration from the smallest successful rung; signed cost, with -200bps as the crossing threshold. The external reUSDe USD mid sizes the input notional and is not the impact reference.
depth.basis: The 2% crossing is bracketed by successful Curve get_dy calls. depth_usd is the largest tested USD input notional that cleared the threshold, not pool TVL. Marginal impact is execution-rate deterioration from the smallest successful rung; the dated external reUSDe USD mid converts each rung's input notional to reUSDe but is not the impact reference. Because the pool output is denominated in sUSDe and no sUSDe USD mark is in scope, neither the smallest-rung baseline nor any rung's execution rate can be reconciled to a dollar price.

denomination_scope.input_notional: USD, converted to reUSDe with the external mid
denomination_scope.exit_cost_scope: Curve venue leg only; this understates complete dollar-exit cost by the unmeasured cost of selling or redeeming sUSDe
denomination_scope.dependency_note: The secondary venue, WindowRedemption payout asset, and 98.97% of issuer-reported combined protocol reserves all depend on sUSDe; these risks are correlated rather than independent.

anchor.fair_value_source: peg_tracker:CoinGecko API external USD aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusde; off-chain market-data API, distinct from the off-chain issuer NAV API and not a contract read

market_price_cross_check.reason: The external anchor is a reUSDe USD mid while the Curve pool prices reUSDe in sUSDe. Computing a market-price bias requires an sUSDe USD mark, which is outside this measurement's scope.

quote.method: eth_call Curve get_dy(int128,int128,uint256), falling through to get_dy(uint256,uint256,uint256)
quote.failed_size_note: get_dy returned no value at $5M, $10M, and the $19M tranche probe. These are failed calls, not threshold-clearing rungs and not depth floors.

primary_exit.gate: Quarterly redemption window; eligibility and released surplus require regulatory approval
primary_exit.capacity_basis: Announced first-window pool; fixed by released surplus under regulatory approval, not a demand-scaling floor

first_window.result: Filled to the announced ceiling within 0.005%; requests met or exceeded capacity and the window was rationed.

primary_exit.note: The primary exit exists but is periodic, regulator-approved, and capped; reUSDe not implementing ERC-4626 does not mean there is no primary exit.

enumeration.source: PegTracker reusde_re backing feed plus DexTracker live Curve query
enumeration.chain_count_note: One measured Ethereum secondary venue; this is not asserted to be a complete venue census.

venues.name: Curve REUSDE/sUSDe
venues.balance_ratio_basis: Not published: the token split in this cross-currency twocrypto pool expresses an exchange rate, not a stableswap imbalance or peg signal.
venues.depth_role: The executable ladder is canonical; TVL is context only.

axis_binding_constraint.basis: The measured Curve-leg 2% depth is materially below the $1.5M quarterly primary-redemption capacity, so the secondary venue is the worse measured leg. Full dollar-exit cost remains understated because sUSDe -> USD is outside this ladder's scope.
